title: 4/13–4/14 the 3am pull/build/preview chain died on `bts data pull` without --start/--end: no fresh blend or preview
tier_reason: liveness failure of the nightly data/preview chain: every 3am run after the crontab reinstall stopped at its first command, so build, preview and the next-day blend were not produced and production ran a blend 2–3 days stale (operator report)

contract.text: The 3am cron chain pulls the latest game feeds, rebuilds the season parquet, produces the preview pick and next-day blend, and syncs to R2.
contract.source: scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh header '03:00 — nightly data refresh + sync to R2 + tomorrow's preview pick' (d5c466c)

mechanism.text: the 3am line ran `bts data pull` with no --start/--end; the command has required both since d991a79 (3/29), so every run exited 'Missing option --start' and the && chain skipped build and preview

mitigated.action: crontab reinstalled from the fixed script (an operator step; deploys do not install crontabs)

residual.text: deploys do not install crontab changes: the fix stays inert until `bash scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh install` runs on the box
a failed 3am chain raised no alert until the blend_training health check (e74c485, 4/27: CRITICAL when tomorrow's blend pickle is missing at end of day)

watchdog.trigger: by 04:30 ET the 3am chain's log shows no completed data build and preview, or by end of day the next day's blend pickle is missing
watchdog.recovery_assertion: today's preview and tomorrow's blend exist and post-date today's 03:00 run

evidence.what: every nightly 3am run short-circuited at `bts data pull` with 'Error: Missing option --start.'; build and preview never ran and no new blend pickle was generated; production ran a blend 2–3 days stale; found by probing the 3am retrain watcher

evidence.locator: src/bts/cli.py pull at d991a79 (3/29) and at dccbfbb
evidence.what: --start and --end are required=True from the command's creation, so the body's 'the CLI was updated to require' is inaccurate: the 3am line was wrong from d5c466c on

evidence.locator: scripts/cron-setup-hetzner.sh at d5c466c and 715c932; src/bts/health/blend_training.py docstring (e74c485)
evidence.what: the 3am line had no --start/--end; the 3am run on day N produces blend_<N+1>.pkl, and a missing pickle makes the next prediction fall back to a stale blend
